description: This Java class provides UI animations for an Android wearable app, enabling zoom-in and zoom-out effects on icons with state management and callbacks.

classes.name: UIAnimation
classes.description: A helper class for handling icon animations and UI state transitions in an Android wearable app.

classes.name: UIAnimation.UIState
classes.description: Enumeration representing different UI states: MIC_UP, SOUND_UP, MUSIC_UP, HOME.

classes.name: UIAnimation.UIStateListener
classes.description: Interface for listening to UI state changes.

methods.name: UIAnimation
methods.description: Constructor initializing the animation with views, duration, and listener.

methods.name: zoomImageFromThumb
methods.description: Handles zoom-in and zoom-out animations for thumbnail images.

methods.name: getUIState
methods.description: Static method to get UIState enum from an integer.

methods.name: transitionToHome
methods.description: Transitions the UI back to the home state by simulating a click.
